title: Exogenous treatment of Arabidopsis seedlings with lyso-phospholipids
author: Platre, Jaillais

steps.title: Make ½ MS agar plates
steps.instruction: Prepare ½ strength MS agar medium and pour plates for seed germination.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 2.2 g L⁻¹ Murashige & Skoog (MS) basal medium (no vitamins) and 1 g L⁻¹ sucrose in 1 L ddH₂O.
Add 8 g L⁻¹ agar, adjust pH to 5.7 with 1 M KOH, autoclave, then keep the molten medium in a 55 °C water bath for at least 3 h (use fresh media).
In a sterile hood, dispense 50 mL of the medium into each 12 × 12 mm square plate.
Leave plates with lids open for 30 min to allow excess humidity to evaporate, then close the lids.
Use plates the same day or store sealed in a bag at 4 °C for up to one week.

steps.title: Sterilize Arabidopsis seeds
steps.instruction: Sterilize seed batches using bleach/HCl vapor in a sealed container.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot each genotype (WT, pss1‑3+/‑, and biosensor line) into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, filling no more than 2 mm from the bottom (~100 µL seeds). Mark tubes with waterproof ink.
Leave tube caps open, place the rack in an airtight plastic box and move the box to a fume hood.
In a 500 mL glass beaker add 200 mL commercial bleach, then carefully add 3.5 mL concentrated HCl (produce chlorine gas).
Place the beaker inside the sealed box, close the box and let react for 1 h.
Open the box, remove the beaker and ventilate the box for 30 min.
Return the box to the sterile hood, keep the tube rack inside with caps open (or optionally close caps for later use).
NOTE: Perform the bleach/HCl step only in a proper fume hood and wear gloves and safety glasses.

steps.title: Sow seeds on agar
steps.instruction: Plate sterilized seeds, stratify, and grow seedlings under controlled light and temperature.

substeps.instruction: In a sterile hood, evenly spread the sterilized seeds onto each ½ MS agar plate.
Seal plates with micropore surgical tape, wrap in aluminum foil and store at 4 °C for 2–3 days (stratification).
After stratification, remove foil and place plates vertically in a growth chamber set to continuous light (150 µE·m⁻²·s⁻¹) at 21 °C for 8–12 days.

steps.title: Prepare lyso‑PS stock solution
steps.instruction: Make a 219 µM lyso‑phospholipid solution in an argon‑saturated vial.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve the vial containing C18:1 lyso‑PS (or lyso‑PA) dissolved in chloroform at 10 mg mL⁻¹ (store at –20 °C, max 1 yr).
Using a 25 µL Hamilton syringe, transfer 12 µL of the lyso‑PS stock (or 10 µL for lyso‑PA) into a 1 mL shell vial.
Evaporate chloroform by flushing the vial with argon gas until a clear lipid film remains at the bottom.
Keep the vial under argon, close the lid and wrap with parafilm. Prepare multiple vials if needed; store sealed at –20 °C (max 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare ½ MS liquid media with lyso‑PS
steps.instruction: Make ½ MS liquid medium, add lyso‑PS stock, and dilute to a working concentration of 54 µM.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.1 g MS basal medium (no vitamins) to 500 mL ddH₂O, adjust pH to 5.7 with 1 M KOH, autoclave, then cool to ~20 °C (room temperature). This is the ½ MS liquid medium.
Aliquot the liquid medium into sterile 50 mL Falcon tubes; store at 4 °C for up to one month. If stored, warm tubes at room temperature for 1 h before use.
In a sterile hood, add 1 mL of the ½ MS liquid medium to the shell vial containing the dried 12 µL lyso‑PS (from step 4); vortex 10 s to resuspend, giving a 219 µM lyso‑PS solution.

Perform a 4× dilution: mix 0.5 mL of the 219 µM solution with 1.5 mL fresh ½ MS liquid medium to obtain 54 µM lyso‑PS. Immediately dispense into one well of a 12‑well plate and use the solution right away.

steps.title: Prepare ½ MS agar plates with lyso‑PS
steps.instruction: Produce agar plates containing ~2.19 µM lyso‑PS for seed growth.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 1.1 g L⁻¹ MS basal medium (no vitamins) in 500 mL ddH₂O, add 4 g L⁻¹ agar, adjust pH to 5.7 with 1 M KOH, autoclave, then keep the molten medium in a 55 °C water bath for at least 3 h (use fresh media). This is the ½ MS agar medium.

In a sterile hood, add 1 mL of ½ MS liquid medium to the shell vial containing the dried 12 µL lyso‑PS (step 4); vortex 10 s. Repeat this addition five times total to obtain 5 mL of a 219 µM lyso‑PS solution.
Combine the 5 mL lyso‑PS solution with 500 mL of the ½ MS agar medium, yielding a final lyso‑PS concentration of ~2.19 µM. Pour the mixture into plates and use the plates the same day.

steps.title: Prepare growing soil
steps.instruction: Set up soil pots for later transplantation of seedlings.

substeps.instruction: Fill each pot with soil and gently press down to compact.
Place the pots into a tray.
Fill the tray with water, allowing the soil to soak for at least 30 min.
